died 1 March 1975 aged 80; joined Belgrave February 1927; won 1932 Olympic 50km walk in Los Angeles (4:50:10); four London to Brighton wins (1929, 1930, 1931, 1933), course record 8:02:55 in 1930; won Manchester to Blackpool six times in a row from 1929; won the Bradford walk 1930, 1932, 1933; National 50km champion; completed walking career at 54; publican at the Meadowbank Hotel and the Crown Hotel, Eastleigh; President of the Eastleigh Cricket Association

photos.c: This photograph is part of the complete one taken at the Belgrave 50th Anniversary Dinner 1937 and shows as numbered some of the club's race walkers of that period. No 7 is Harold King (see obituary notice) others are 1. Chas Churcher, 2. Harry Churcher, 3. Joe Coleman, 4. Tommy Green, 5. Jack Bidgood and 6. Frank Elson.
